text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
This card may digivolve from the hand onto one of your yellow Tamers as if that card is a level 3 yellow Digimon.
[When Attacking] ＜Draw 1＞
[When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞.

qa.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.
qa.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can. If you do, it's treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, it won't be possible to use this effect to treat that Tamer as a Digimon.
qa.question: When using the [Koji Minamoto]: Cost 2 digivolution requirement to digivolve, can I use a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect to treat that [Koji Minamoto] as a Digimon for digivolving?

qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?

qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?

qa.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.
Related Cards
qa.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?

qa.answer: No, this card's [When Attacking] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
qa.question: When I use this card's 2nd [When Attacking] effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

qa.answer:
They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player chooses the effect to activate first.
However, if you activate the 2nd [When Attacking] effect first and digivolve, the 1st [When Attacking] can no longer be activated.
qa.question: When this card attacks, which of its 2 [When Attacking] effects activate first?

qa.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.
